items.title: False claims that drinking water with lemon can prevent COVID-19 circulate online
items.snippet_en: Claims that drinking warm water with lemon can prevent coronavirus are false, as experts have found no proof of its effectiveness.

items.title: Common Myths about Coronavirus Explained
items.snippet_en: Home remedies, including warm water or lemon juice, are not effective against COVID-19 or any other virus.

items.title: Drinking hot water, lemon and baking soda will not cure coronavirus
items.snippet_en: Social media posts claiming hot water with lemon and bicarbonate of soda can cure coronavirus are false; deaths occurred in Israel despite such claims.

items.title: What about drinking lemon in hot water, or other home remedies?
items.snippet_en: Hot drinks with lemon do not eliminate the virus and have no impact on immune response or virus elimination.

items.title: Does drinking lemon juice mixed with baking soda or aspirin kill COVID-19?
items.snippet_en: Consuming acidic drinks like lemon juice has no effect on coronavirus infections and will not destroy viruses or stop their copying process.

items.title: Will Drinking Lemon Juice Kill The Coronavirus? Dr. Mallika Marshall Answers Your Questions - CBS Boston
items.snippet_en: Consuming acidic liquids will not kill the coronavirus.
